features.name: Duelist Training
features.desc: You gain proficiency with Medium armor and the Scimitar (and other Martial weapons); you can use it as a spellcasting focus.

features.name: Blade Flourish
features.desc: When you take the Attack action, you can expend a Bardic Inspiration die on a flourish: Defensive (+AC), Slashing (extra damage to the target and a second creature), or Mobile (extra damage + movement without provoking).

features.name: Extra Attack
features.desc: You can attack twice, instead of once, whenever you take the Attack action.

features.name: Master's Flourish
features.desc: You can use Blade Flourish without expending a Bardic Inspiration die (you roll a d6 instead).
